title: Supported platforms
content:
# Supported platforms

Every platform you can post to, answer messages on, read analytics from or run ads on through the Zernio MCP server or CLI.

Connect these in the Zernio app. A check means you can ask for it on that platform.

## Social Posting

- X: Post, Analytics, DMs, Comments
- Instagram: Post, Analytics, DMs, Comments
- Facebook: Post, Analytics, DMs, Comments, Reviews
- LinkedIn: Post, Analytics, Comments
- TikTok: Post, Analytics, DMs, Comments
- YouTube: Post, Analytics, Comments
- Pinterest: Post, Analytics
- Reddit: Post, Analytics, DMs, Comments
- Bluesky: Post, Analytics, DMs, Comments
- Threads: Post, Analytics, Comments
- Google Business Profile: Post, Analytics, Reviews
- Snapchat: Post, Analytics

## Messaging

- WhatsApp: Post, DMs
- RCS: DMs
- iMessage: DMs
- Telegram: Post, DMs
- Discord: Post
- Slack: Post, DMs
- LINE: DMs
- WeChat: DMs

## Telephony

- SMS: DMs

## Advertising

- Meta Ads: Ads
- Google Ads: Ads
- LinkedIn Ads: Ads
- TikTok Ads: Ads
- Pinterest Ads: Ads
- X Ads: Ads
- OpenAI Ads: Ads
- Reddit Ads: Ads
- Microsoft Ads: Ads

## Blogs & Commerce

- Shopify: Blog articles (no social posts)
- WordPress: Blog articles (no social posts)
- Wix: Blog articles (no social posts)
- Webflow: Blog articles (no social posts)

## CRM

- HubSpot: None (syncs inbox contacts and messages)

## Analytics

- Google Analytics: None (reads GA4 reports)

## Payments

- Stripe: None (payments become Purchase events)

## Email & Calendar

- Google: Email, Calendar, Files, Contacts
- Microsoft: Email, Calendar, Files, Contacts
- IMAP: Email

## Platform rules

Each platform has its own limits on text length, video length and file size.
